reason: This sits right in our order path, and I won't put an early-stage startup with no customers and no SOC 2 report there, not even for free. My examiner asked how we control AI. Telling them our control is an unaudited startup's proxy makes my next exam harder, not easier.
objection: No SOC 2, no customers, no track record. If their proxy goes down or makes a wrong call, our customers' orders stall or go through when they shouldn't, and I'm the one explaining it to FINRA. The 'free for six months' pilot also comes with a letter of intent and a reference I'd be putting my name on.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus at least one comparable regulated broker already running it in production that I can call.
